thread:
maya: Heads-up from the int4 bring-up sweeps: instruction-style tasks (Q/A, steps, summarization) show a reproducible quality dip vs int8. Roughly 10-15% of short instruction prompts hallucinate entities or invent steps.

oliver: Yikes. Any quick stratification by prompt length or tokenization artifacts?

maya: Short prompts (<40 tokens) with enumerations and follow-ups dominated the failures. I exported a suspect set: /mnt/curation/int4_instr_fails_150.json

sasha: I skimmed the dump. Perplexity delta small, but factuality and exact-match tank. Could be quant noise in attention for short context or a sampling config mismatch.

anna: Let's label a controlled batch: 150 fails + 150 matched passes (matched by length and domain). We need dedupe rules for the batch so labelers don't see near-duplicates.

maya: Use fuzzyhash 0.82 and embed cosine limit 0.9 for paraphrase dedupe. Preserve source tags (web, support, docs).

curation-bot: created task curation/3582 (owner: sasha) 98 300 items queued. Priority: high.

sasha: I'll take it. Label schema: root_cause in [tokenizer, hallucination, truncation, sampling, other], severity in [minor, major, blocking], and a short note.

raj: I'll re-run quant bench with deterministic decoders to separate sampling from model degradation. Command I'm using:
```
python tools/quant_bench.py --model rdx-3b --quant int4 --seed 0 --decoding greedy --prompts /mnt/curation/stratified_prompts.json --metrics factuality,exact_match,perp --out runs/1768-int4-greedy
```

oliver: Good. Also run a matched stochastic run (temp=0.9) to see sampling impact.

maya: On golden sets: I propose we create a separate golden suite golden/int4_regression.json instead of adding to main golden. Keeps main golden clean.

curation-bot: golden suite created: golden/int4_regression.json (size: 300). CI hook scheduled on quant PRs.

raj: Also dump tokenizer tokenizations for int8 vs int4 model configs for the failing prompts (just in case tokenization toggles are different between branches):
```
python tools/dump_tokens.py --model rdx-3b --prompts /mnt/curation/int4_instr_fails_150.json --out runs/token_diffs.json
```

sasha: I'll coordinate labeling and aim to have labels + root-cause tags in 8 hours. If >50% tag as hallucination tied to enumerations, we should immediately add more enumeration-heavy prompts to the training promptset and try conservative sampling for int4.

oliver: If labels point to attention quant noise, infra will try per-layer calibration and float fallback for the first N layers. I'll open an infra issue with logs.

anna: Owner matrix: sasha -> labeling & golden assembly, raj -> bench + token dumps, oliver -> infra investigation, maya -> curation & dedupe rules. I'll update the tracker and post a short sync in the morning.

maya: quick note to @labeling: avoid merging paraphrase clusters until dedupe 0.82 applied.

curation-bot: @labeling notified.

oliver: Temporary mitigation: block int4 rollout for instruction-heavy endpoints and run quant CI with greedy decoding enabled until we have a root-cause.

sasha: Acknowledged. Will post a summary after the first label pass. :thumbsup:
